verdict.rationale: The evidence shows JumpCloud enforces SSO and MFA across SAML and OIDC apps and offers passwordless access to web resources, which supports the 'sign in once' part of the story. A community user also says its SSO works reasonably well. Nothing in the pack describes an employee-facing launcher dashboard or a browser extension that lists the apps a user is assigned, so the portal experience itself is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented user portal or app-launcher dashboard, a browser extension, display of assigned apps per user, and independent hands-on corroboration of the portal experience.
